title: 第3729章 两大巅峰上位神诀第3728章 好蠢的样子
slug: 邪鼎第3739章本祖是她的师尊
content_zh:
时间宛若指间沙，二十八天眨眼即逝。
距离黄泉试炼开启，仅剩两天。
连续二十八天的猎杀，极寒之地的中位神妖兽，几乎被苏凡和殷三元杀绝。
至于上位神妖兽，他们没去理会。
因为现在，苏凡也就中位神的修为，魔王鼎还无法提炼上位神妖兽。
嗖！
殷三元带着苏凡，飞进一个冰谷。
这二十几天，李有德等人都在冰谷里闭关修炼。
苏凡看向李有德：“怎么样？”
李有德睁开眼，长身而起，放出修为气息，如愿踏入四境中位神。
“时间已经所剩不多，赶紧去星辰殿。”
“而且只剩下两天时间，等去了星辰殿，天衍老祖应该也不会再让小爷去学炼丹。”
苏凡呲牙一笑。
“所以，你是故意拖到现在才去星辰殿的？”
李有德将时间神玉递给苏凡。
苏凡瞪去：“有没有人告诉你，看破不说破？”
李有德竖起中指。
德行。
大黑狗睁开眼：“气血珠提炼了多少？”
苏凡摇头：“不知道，数量太多没清点，应该足够我们修炼到上位神。”

“那就好。”
“把所有的主神器都给本皇，我们就在这分道扬镳。”
一想到要去血族和天使一族，大黑狗也不打瞌睡了，干劲十足。
“那你小心点，别到时死在血族和天使一族，还要让我们去给你收尸。”
苏凡把魔王鼎，洛水神玉，板砖取出来，叮嘱道。
李有德也取出魔王左手扔给大黑狗：“就我们现在的实力，也没能力去给你收尸。”
大黑狗眉毛一挑：“看来临走前，得先帮你们松松皮。”
它一把抓住板砖，按着苏凡两人就是一顿捶。
两人哀嚎不已。
片刻后，大黑狗拍了拍爪子，低头看着躺在地上的两人：“还嚣张不？”
两人摇头如拨浪鼓。
不敢了。
“小样。”
大黑狗满眼不屑：“本皇也不白揍你们，临别前，送你们两道强大的巅峰级上位神诀，助你们在黄泉试炼杀敌。”
苏凡两人相视，一脸振奋地爬起来。
一下就送他们两道巅峰级上位神诀？
我勒个去！
不愧是狗子哥，大手笔。
大黑狗抬起两只小爪子，按在两人的眉心，两股庞大的信息，如潮水般涌入两人的脑海。
巅峰级上位神诀，五行神典！
content_en:
Time is like sand between fingers, twenty-eight days go by in the blink of an eye.
There are only two days left before the Underworld Trial begins.
After twenty-eight consecutive days of hunting, the mid-level divine monsters in the extremely cold land were almost wiped out by Su Fan and Yin Sanyuan.
As for the higher-level gods and monsters, they ignored them.
Because now, Su Fan is only at the level of a mid-level god, and the Demon King Cauldron is still unable to refine upper-level god monsters.
Whoosh!
Yin Sanyuan took Su Fan and flew into an ice valley.
In the past twenty days, Li Youde and others have been practicing in retreat in the Ice Valley.
Su Fan looked at Li Youde: "How is it?"
Li Youde opened his eyes, stood up, released his cultivation aura, and stepped into the middle god of the four realms as he wished.
"There is not much time left, hurry to the Star Palace."
"And there are only two days left. When we get to the Star Palace, Patriarch Tianyan probably won't let me learn alchemy anymore."
Su Fan bared his teeth and smiled.
"So, you delayed going to the Star Palace until now on purpose?"
Li Youde handed the time jade to Su Fan.
Su Fan glared: "Did anyone tell you that you can't tell the truth when you see it?"
Li Youde raised his middle finger.
Virtue.
The big black dog opened his eyes: "How many Qi and blood beads have been refined?"
Su Fan shook his head: "I don't know. There are too many and I haven't counted them. It should be enough for us to cultivate to a higher god."
"That's good."
"Give all the main artifacts to me, and we will part ways here."
When he thought about going to the vampire and angel clans, the big black dog stopped dozing off and became very motivated.
"Then be careful, don't die among the vampires and angels, and let us collect your body."
Su Fan took out the Demon King's Cauldron, the Luoshui Divine Jade, and the bricks, and warned them.
Li Youde also took out the Demon King's left hand and threw it to the big black dog: "With our current strength, we are not capable of collecting your body."
The big black dog raised his eyebrows: "It seems that before I leave, I have to loosen the skin for you."
It grabbed the bricks, held down Su Fan and beat them.
The two of them were wailing.
After a while, the big black dog clapped his paws and looked down at the two people lying on the ground: "Are you still arrogant?"
The two shook their heads like rattles.
Don't dare anymore.
"Small sample."
The big black dog looked with disdain in his eyes: "I will not beat you in vain. Before I leave, I will give you two powerful pinnacle-level divine arts to help you test and kill the enemy in the underworld."
Su Fan looked at each other and got up excitedly.
Give them two peak-level divine arts at once?
What the hell!
As expected of Brother Gouzi, he is generous.
The big black dog raised its two small paws and pressed them between their eyebrows. Two huge streams of information flooded into their minds like a tide.
The pinnacle-level Divine Secret, the Five Elements Divine Code!
